name: Momose Katsuko
source:
President of "Trustworthiness Investigation Company Freesia."


Chaos;Child: [spoiler]She is Kunosato's legal guardian, and also Serika's in the true ending.[/spoiler]

Chaos;Head Noah: [spoiler]She is a Debugger working for or with the Committee of 300, informing them from the shadows about anything that might help or serve as an obstacle, all to fulfill their ambition of bringing order to the world.[/spoiler]
